blocks.inside_description: Cracked tiles crunch underfoot, their once-pristine white surface now mottled with dirt. Scattered medical charts and syringes lie forgotten, hinting at an abrupt evacuation. The remnants of a wheelchair lie overturned, its wheels broken and frame bent.
blocks.name: Mountain Pines General Hospital
blocks.outside_description: A collapsed awning lies in a heap near the entrance, rusted metal and torn fabric intertwined. Broken stretchers and IV poles are scattered around the entrance, abandoned in the rush to escape. Graffiti covers the lower walls, a mix of desperate warnings and crude symbols.

blocks.inside_description: The walls are lined with rusted tools, long since abandoned and gathering dust in the airless room. A disarray of equipment and abandoned firefighting gear litters the floor, untouched for years. Broken fire hoses and empty oxygen tanks litter the station's once-busy floor.
blocks.name: The Redoubt Fire Department
blocks.outside_description: A weathered emblem of a firetruck remains above the door, though time has worn it nearly to obscurity. A faded fire truck sits abandoned outside, its tires deflated and frame rusted. Debris has collected along the walls, mixed with splinters of wood and glass.

blocks.inside_description: Cracked tiles crunch underfoot, their once-pristine white surface now mottled with dirt. Bloodstains mar the walls and floors, long dried and darkened to a deep rust-red. An old intercom crackles to life momentarily, emitting an unintelligible burst of static.
blocks.name: Crescent Valley Health Center
blocks.outside_description: The facade is crumbling, with a faded red cross barely visible against the peeling paint. The roof has partially caved in, leaving a gaping hole that exposes the skeletal remains of upper floors. Graffiti covers the lower walls, a mix of desperate warnings and crude symbols.

blocks.inside_description: The tower lobby opens onto a stairwell and a row of motionless lift doors. Broken office furniture lies beneath the directory beside the reception desk. Every corner bears the traces of people who left in haste and never returned.
blocks.name: Brightmoor Towers
blocks.outside_description: The tower rises above the neighbouring roofs, its upper windows pale with dust. Chunks of fallen masonry lie beside the entrance beneath a cracked company sign. Higher up, torn blinds flutter behind broken glass against the empty skyline.

blocks.inside_description: The hotel lobby opens onto dusty corridors lined with numbered guest rooms. Old fittings hang crookedly along walls marked by years of damp and neglect. Every corner bears the traces of people who left in haste and never returned.

blocks.outside_description: Cracked paving and windblown litter surround the entrance to the deserted site. Weathered signs and broken fixtures offer small reminders of its former use. Curtains stir behind broken panes while scraps of paper drift across the drive.
